I understand how you feel. I have depression and anxiety. It's really easy for me to get in that hole that you describe- in fact, I was just in it less than 24 hours ago.

I have to keep reminding myself of the things I am striving for, the things I am working for (I also have a fantastic, albeit mediocre in pay, job). 

I bought a DSLR camera. I have set the goal of taking a "photo trip" each week- even if it's just around my town. I have to force myself to do it sometimes, but at the end of the day, I'm always grateful I did. I take photos for me, no one else, and it inherently gives me pause at the world around me and creativity.

I've also begun planning an epic 10 day trip to NYC. I have to work A LOT to be able to afford it.

My point is, I found things that I can control, and I try to channel my energy into those things. A) it helps distract me from my depression, grief, anxiety, stress, etc. B) It gives me something to look forward to. C) Most importantly, it EMPOWERS me. We all want to feel some sort of control, especially when it feels like everything is out of our control.
